# Astro Maintenance Skill

1. Search before editing and reuse existing data/utilities.
2. Keep calculation engines independent from presentation.
3. Prefer canonical tables/constants over duplicated arrays.
4. Add regression coverage for corrected calculations.
5. Review Tamil-facing strings for standard astrology terminology.
6. Update README/docs when behavior or supported features change.
7. Do not run production builds for documentation-only, README-only, or .github-only changes.
8. For source changes, run lint and production build.

Completion: no duplicate data, routes preserved, tests added where needed, Tamil terminology reviewed, docs updated, source checks clean.
